subject: Exec demo — stretch window and step-down coverage plan
body:
---- Message 1 ----
Date: Wed, Nov 3, 2027 at 9:12 AM
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@aeristech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Exec demo — stretch window and step-down coverage plan

Hi Simon —

Thanks for taking the time earlier. We’d love to run a focused exec demo for AerisTech that covers: key latency/cost tradeoffs, private deployment options (VPC/on-prem), and an architecture Q&A for your CIO. To make sure Elaine gets the details she needs, would you prefer a standard 45-minute presentation + 15 QA, or we can "stretch" the session to 70 minutes (40 demo + 30 deep Q&A)?

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue 2027-11-10: 10:00–11:10 or 14:00–15:10
- Thu 2027-11-12: 13:00–14:10

I’m attaching an updated mutual action plan and a short tech question worksheet so we can prep the right folks. If Elaine will attend, we’d suggest the stretch + we’ll add a step-down coverage plan — Ben will cover architecture if Elaine needs to step out, and Karthik can handle licensing/pricing specifics.

Please let me know which window you prefer and any other attendees to include.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_AerisTech_v2.pdf

---- Message 2 ----
Date: Wed, Nov 3, 2027 at 11:03 AM
From: Simon Liu <simon.liu@aeristech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@aeristech.com>
Subject: Re: Exec demo — stretch window and step-down coverage plan

Marissa,

Thanks — Elaine would like to join and is particularly interested in the private deployment and high-availability story. She also requested a deeper discussion on encryption key management (KMS/HSM) and audit logs. If we go the longer format that sounds ideal.

Elaine: I’ve looped you in so you can confirm availability. Our preference right now is Thu 11/12 at 13:00 PT but I can confirm by EOD. We also have a tight calendar that week, so a backup plan if Elaine needs to step out would be helpful.

Simon
Head of Engineering, AerisTech

---- Message 3 ----
Date: Wed, Nov 3, 2027 at 11:45 AM
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@aeristech.com>, Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@aeristech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Exec demo — stretch window and step-down coverage plan

Perfect — thanks for the quick reply, Simon. If Thu 11/12 at 13:00 PT works for Elaine that’s our preference too. Two quick clarifications and a coverage proposal: 

1) Agenda tweaks (stretch format, 70m):
- 13:00–13:40: Exec-focused demo (latency/cost, model routing, fallback policies)
- 13:40–14:10: Deep architecture dive + KMS/HSM and audit logs (Ben leads)
- 14:10–14:15: Next steps and action items

2) Step-down coverage plan: if Elaine needs to step out mid-demo, Ben will continue the architecture session; Olga will take notes and capture SOC 2/compliance asks; Karthik will be on standby for pricing/commit/licensing questions. We’ll keep the session recorded and share the MAP.

3) Pre-reads & prep: I attached an updated Mutual Action Plan and a short workbook of technical questions — can you flag any must-answer items so Ben can prep slides?

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_AerisTech_v2.pdf, Prospect_Technical_Questions.xlsx

If that all looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for 11/12 13:00–14:10 PT and include a WebEx link.

Thanks,
Marissa

---- Message 4 ----
Date: Thu, Nov 4, 2027 at 8:15 AM
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Re: Exec demo — stretch window and step-down coverage plan

I’m good for 11/12 and can own the architecture/KMS + HA slides. I’ll prep a short backup slide set in case Elaine wants examples of on-prem key flows and our HSM integration notes. Karthik — can you prep the brief pricing SKUs we’d show for Dedicated vs Hosted during the Q&A?

—Ben

---- Message 5 ----
Date: Fri, Nov 5, 2027 at 3:47 PM
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Simon Liu <simon.liu@aeristech.com>, Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@aeristech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Subject: Confirmed: Exec demo Thu 2027-11-12 13:00 PT — agenda + links

Thanks everyone — confirmed for Thu, Nov 12, 2027 13:00–14:10 PT. Final attendee list so far:
- Elaine Nguyen (CIO) — AerisTech
- Simon Liu (Head of Engineering) — AerisTech
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Demo lead
- Ben Carter (Redwood) — Architecture & KMS deep-dive
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — Pricing & procurement notes
- Olga Petrov (Redwood) — Compliance notes / SOC 2 follow-ups

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcdef123456
Recording & follow-ups will be posted to the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/AER-2027-0421

Agenda (final):
- 13:00–13:40: Executive demo (Marissa)
- 13:40–14:10: Architecture deep dive + KMS/HSM & audit logs (Ben)
- 14:10–14:15: Next steps — MAP items and owners (Marissa)

Simon/ Elaine — a small favor: if you can reply with the top 3 technical questions from the workbook before EOD 11/10, Ben will tailor the deep-dive slides to those asks.

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_AerisTech_v2.pdf, Prospect_Technical_Questions.xlsx
